newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Netanyahu to Jordan on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu to Jordan on Sunday.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will travel to Amman on Sunday for a meeting with Jordan's King Hussein, his office said on Friday.
The two men will meet in the afternoon and hold a joint news conference at 6.30 p.m. (1630 GMT), a spokesman said.
Netanyahu cancelled a trip to Jordan scheduled for earlier this month after 73 Israeli soldiers were killed in a helicopter collision.
Israel and Jordan signed a peace agreement in 1994.
